measurement_status.evidence: Four complete Huginn N256/B1/64-token traces (16,384 rows each); eight reused Ouro Phase-1 traces; nine selected physical 32-token cells with two warmups and three or five measured repetitions per strategy, final N256 and controls using five; synchronized CUDA-event recurrent time and prefill-excluded decode wall time; physical_matrix.csv and raw run manifests/summary files
measurement_status.known_missing_fields: No pinned Hugging Face dataset revisions in raw manifests, no native full-depth quality/latency comparison, no output-quality equality check, no confidence interval beyond repeat distributions
measurement_status.fixed_decode_contract: exactly N times num_tokens generated positions, no EOS stop; prefill excluded from wall time but included in peak HBM

implementation_status.evidence: Physical survivor-only recurrent calls and stable logical KV rows; Ouro last-exited depth-indexed KV; Huginn shared physical-layer KV; complete Huginn trace collector uses the same adapter/exit/KV semantics as live runtime; N4 x 2-token validation matches all eight exit depths and prompt hash; shared-KV capacity fix prevents old growing reservation; eight CPU invariant tests passed
implementation_status.failure_preserved: physical/gpu7_huginn/phase02_physical_gpu7_huginn_20260916T130250Z_4129364/failure_receipt.json; interrupted at observed 74,219 MiB before H100 OOM, not counted as a complete trace

simulator_status.evidence: 12 source traces x N32/64/128/256 x B4/8/16/32 = 192 complete divisible cells at each 64- and 32-token horizon; same frozen first-N request IDs, true-depth Oracle sort with stable request-ID ties, no refill or partial microbatches; all N=B controls have zero RIC delta; all 12 published compressed trace input hashes match decompressed source hashes; all nine physical cells match the 32-token trace-sim FIFO/Oracle RIC and same-work checksum
simulator_status.metric_scope: RIC and logical slot utilization only; not throughput or BCT

comparison_status.baselines: FIFO versus perfect-current-depth Oracle on the same selected requests, model, threshold, B, prompts, generation count, exit-depth work, and KV backend; zero-headroom N=B controls for both models
comparison_status.denominator_checks: Physical request/token work SHA and total request-recurrence work equal within each pair; nine of nine physical calls/checksums equal 32-token trace-sim; N256 Huginn physical Alpaca prompt SHA equals its B=1 collector SHA in three of three selected cells
comparison_status.known_mismatch: Ouro Phase-1 native-reference depths came from uncapped prompts, while physical model prompts were capped at 64 tokens: four of 256 Alpaca and 80 of 256 ShareGPT selected prompts were truncated. Thus Ouro physical comparisons prove forced-depth hardware behavior, not original-context live dataset throughput. Huginn prompt cap and content match.

hypothesis_status.counterevidence: The Huginn threshold-0.50 64-token RIC reduction is only 15.0%; even at threshold 0.12 physical wall improvement (16.2%) is smaller than 32-token RIC reduction (20.6%); N=B controls show no material gain

artifacts.trace_inputs: trace_inputs/*.jsonl.gz; raw-byte hashes after decompression listed in trace_sim_64tok/run_manifest.json
artifacts.physical_raw: physical/gpu6_ouro/ and physical/gpu7_huginn/; recurrence_events.jsonl.gz is lossless, summary CSV line endings normalized to LF

exact_command_or_receipt: The run_manifest.json in each physical directory contains the runner argv and source/GPU/model/trace/prompt bindings; trace_sim_64tok/run_manifest.json and trace_sim_32tok/run_manifest.json contain the complete trace inputs, N/B grid, horizon, source SHA, and metric scope. Reproduce the CPU checks with python -m unittest phase02_runtime.test_oracle_ric phase02_runtime.test_summarize_oracle_physical phase02_runtime.test_runtime -v.
next_action: One bounded predictor block: predict expected microbatch maxima/RIC for the strongest N256/B32 Huginn and Ouro regimes, compare practical wall-time recovery against these physical Oracle/FIFO ceilings and N=B controls, and profile fixed prelude/coda/KV overhead; do not infer quality or deployment readiness.
